entry.title: UniFi Access Point for U6-LR, U6-Lite, U6+ & more 6.7.54
entry.summary:
Overview This release is only for these models:
U6-LR/U6-Lite/U6+ UAP-nanoHD/FlexHD/BeaconHD/IW-HD
Improvements
Improved client connectivity and roam event reporting. Improved Auto-Link compatibility. Improved stability.
Bugfixes
Fixed an issue where Auto Channel Selection on 2.4 GHz could select restricted channels. Fixed connectivity issues where UDB-IoT clients could not access the internet. Fixed an issue where UDB-IoT clients could not reach certain clients connected to UniFi APs. Fixed an issue where channel width was not synchronized on meshed APs. Fixed an issue causing clients to get stuck in a roaming loop between 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz. Fixed an issue where clients could not connect using OWE. Fixed an issue where clients were repeatedly rejected by the AP. Fixed an issue where AP configuration would not be saved properly. Fixed an issue where the AP would fail to broadcast beacons.
Additional information Update your devices by changing the Device Firmware Release Channel in the UniFi Network application to Release Candidate.
If you wish to go back to the Official release after the upgrade, change the release channel back to Official.
---- If you encounter any issues with this release, please provide us with some details on your setup and include the below information:
AP model(s) Previous AP release version UniFi Network application version
